olivia - AE: Quick thread for client NovaCare: want a 7-day Private POC. They run onprem inference + AWS accounts. Ask: recommend PrivateLink vs TGW, TLS inspect implications, and a tight POC network cost estimate they can sign off on.

sam - solutions eng: TL;DR: PrivateLink is fastest to stand up and isolates access per-VPC. TGW/transit scales better and preserves src-ip easier if they control routing. For a short POC PrivateLink usually wins.

tony - netops: Ops caveats: PrivateLink needs an ENI in each AZ you use for HA. If their edge SNATs traffic we'll see ENI IPs not client IPs 1 use 1:1 NAT or route without SNAT if they need src-ip. For TGW we need route exchange (BGP or static) and potentially firewall peering rules.

mei - security: TLS inspect note: if their DLP terminates TLS, mutual-TLS and client-cert auth fail. Streaming may break if TLS is proxied/buffered. Recommend a passthrough/bypass rule for our endpoint CIDRs or use end-to-end mTLS. We'll provide language for their security questionnaire.

olivia - AE: They also want a short firewall snippet they can paste and a cost line for a 7-day POC with ~4TB egress.

tony - netops: Pasteable snippet (replace CIDRs with list we upload):
- proto: tcp
  ports: [443]
  dest_cidr: ["10.240.16.0/28","10.240.17.0/28"]
  description: "Allow Redwood Private ENIs"
# preserve client IP: ensure no SNAT between app subnets and ENI route or use 1:1 NAT

sam - solutions eng: Ballpark POC network add-on: PrivateLink endpoint ~$0.015/hr per endpoint + data processing ~$0.01/GB. For 4TB (~4000GB) data ~ $40 + endpoint hours (2 AZ) =~ $3.5 -> ~ $44. If they prefer TGW it may avoid endpoint fees but could add inter-AZ transfer/NAT costs.

mei - security: Action: I'll draft the questionnaire bullets (SOC2, TLS1.3, KMS options, audit retention) and the TLS-inspect bypass text.

tony - netops: Action: I'll upload exact ENI CIDRs and a SNAT iptables example to ticket NC-POC-22 by 1600 PT.
